item.text:
**Bottom line**
Khamenei looks only **slightly closer on narrow power-consolidation and anti-Israel influence**, but **not clearly closer on a durable broad program**. The year produced some tactical wins and tighter elite control, yet the stronger pattern is still economic weakness, managed politics, and coercive governance. For 8B.10, I’d treat the evidence as **mixed to modestly negative on durable achievement**, with the strongest positives being conditional or short-lived.

**Accepted Claims**
- **Khamenei and Raisi Speeches on Nowruz** | **The Iran Primer** | **2024-03-21** | [link](https://iranprimer.usip.org/index.php/blog/2024/mar/21/khamenei-and-raisi-speeches-nowruz)  
  - Claim: Khamenei explicitly framed domestic production as the fix for inflation, jobs, and currency weakness, and said foreign deals should become concrete executive contracts. This is the clearest statement of his economic program, but it is still rhetoric rather than proof of durable progress.  
  - IDs: `8B.10`

- **Iran signals no plan to retaliate against Israel after drone attack** | **Reuters** | **2024-04-19** | [link](https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/israel-attacks-iran-sources-say-drones-reported-over-isfahan-3443091)  
  - Claim: After the Isfahan incident, Tehran publicly downplayed the attack and indicated no retaliation, which Reuters said appeared aimed at averting wider war. This is a real short-term restraint signal, but it was tactical and limited.  
  - IDs: `8B.10`

- **Iran’s presidential election dominated by Khamenei loyalists** | **Reuters** | **2024-06-25** | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879)  
  - Claim: Khamenei ensured hardline candidates dominated the snap presidential race, with the Guardian Council approving only five hardliners and one moderate from 80 applicants. This is strong evidence of power consolidation through loyalist filtering.  
  - IDs: `8B.10`

- **Iran offers to cap sensitive uranium stock as IAEA resolution looms** | **Reuters** | **2024-11-20** | [link](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2024/11/20/world/politics/iran-uranium-stock-iaea/)  
  - Claim: Iran offered a conditional cap on near-weapons-grade uranium as a way to avoid an IAEA resolution. This is the best concrete restraint move in the nuclear file, but it was conditional and fragile rather than durable reform.  
  - IDs: `8B.10`

- **Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says** | **Reuters** | **2024-12-14** | [link](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/)  
  - Claim: Iran said it would not obstruct IAEA inspections and would operate within safeguards. This is a late-year procedural restraint signal, but it is narrow and does not prove broad policy improvement.  
  - IDs: `8B.10`

- **Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel** | **Reuters** | **2024-10-05** | [link](https://theprint.in/world/iran-is-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/)  
  - Claim: In his first Friday sermon in nearly five years, Khamenei called for more anti-Israel struggle and urged allies to intensify resistance. This is strong evidence of an actively revealed hardline regional program, not a move toward de-escalation or moderation.  
  - IDs: `8B.10`

- **IAEA board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors** | **Reuters** | **2024-06-05** | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087)  
  - Claim: The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors after Iran removed many experienced inspectors. This is strong negative evidence on nuclear discipline and cooperation, and it undercuts any claim of steady institutional improvement.  
  - IDs: `8B.10`

**Search gap**
I found no strong independent evidence that 2024 produced a durable, measurable improvement in Khamenei’s broader economic or governance program. The main positives are rhetorical, conditional, or tactical; the strongest negatives are structural and repeated across the year.
